pages.text: Altered from $(5)Knockback$(), $(4)Soaring$() shoots up any enemy hit, with level increasing height. The enemy also receives a short Slow Falling effect, negating fall damage. Maximum level is $(4)II$() and it conflicts with $(5)Knockback$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: While its primary use case is controlling the enemy's movements, it can still be used alongside other 'weapons', such as placing a Bucket of Lava below the soaring enemy.
